{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the mean of biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Also check the batch correction: batch B values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# The data dictionary says batch B reports in µg/L, so 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL
# So, correct batch B values by dividing by 10
# But note: the data dictionary says 'batch-B `biomarker_final` values are 10× too large' → divide by 10

# Apply correction: only batch B needs correction
# Create a copy to avoid modifying original
df_corrected = df_dedup.copy()
df_corrected.loc[df_corrected['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Compute corrected mean
mean_biomarker_final_corrected = df_corrected['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print the corrected mean
print(mean_biomarker_final_corrected)"}
